config.instructions: Choose the source file path most likely to contain direct evidence for the issue. Judge paths only; no file contents or directory summaries are available. Choose none only if no listed path could contain relevant evidence.
config.ordering: SHA-256 of issue ID plus NUL plus path
config.method: Choice top-16 tournament over all eligible path names
config.timeout_retries: up to 3 on TimeoutError/URLError; delays 1, 2, 4 seconds
